crossRefs.note: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money…
He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two coats each.
Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.
He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, wallet, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”
What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock…

translations.web: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.
translations.bsb: Do not carry any gold or silver or copper in your belts.
translations.kjv: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
translations.asv: Get you no gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses;
